spec.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT node_id) as nodes 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'performance_metrics_by_node' AND $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT appliance_id) as appliances 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'performance_metrics_by_appliance' AND $__timeFilter(time)

SELECT last_physical_used, (last_physical_total - last_physical_used) as "Free"
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' AND entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster' AND $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT time, (CAST(last_physical_used AS DOUBLE) / CAST(last_physical_total AS DOUBLE)) AS "Used %"
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' AND entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster' AND $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, spa, spb
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter LIKE '%$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND path IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT ON (name) name, (("sizeTotal") - ("sizeUsed")) as free, time 
FROM unity_metrics 
WHERE datacenter = '$datacenter' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND "sizeTotal" IS NOT NULL AND name ~ '^Pool' 
ORDER BY name, time DESC;

SELECT datacenter, name,"sizeUsed", "sizeAllocated", "sizeTotal" 
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (datacenter, name) 
        datacenter, 
        name, 
        "sizeUsed", 
        "sizeAllocated", 
        "sizeTotal",
        time
    FROM unity_metrics 
    WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' 
      AND $__timeFilter(time) 
      AND resource_type = 'filesystem' 
    ORDER BY datacenter, name, time DESC
) latest_metrics
ORDER BY "sizeUsed" DESC

SELECT datacenter, name, "sizeTotal", "sizeUsed", "sizeSubscribed", free, percent_used 
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (datacenter, name) 
        datacenter, 
        name, 
        "sizeTotal", 
        "sizeUsed", 
        "sizeSubscribed", 
        (("sizeUsed" * 100) / "sizeTotal") as percent_used, 
        ("sizeTotal" - "sizeUsed") as free, 
        time
    FROM unity_metrics 
    WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' 
      AND $__timeFilter(time) 
      AND resource_type = 'pool' 
    ORDER BY datacenter, name, time DESC
) latest_metrics
ORDER BY percent_used DESC;

SELECT time, last_logical_provisioned, last_logical_used, last_physical_total, 
  last_physical_used, last_data_physical_used, last_system_free_space, 
  last_unreducible_data 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster' 
  AND datacenter = '$datacenter' 
  AND cluster_id = '$cluster'
  AND $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, avg_read_latency, avg_write_latency, avg_latency, 
  avg_read_iops, avg_write_iops, avg_total_iops, 
  avg_read_bandwidth, avg_write_bandwidth, avg_total_bandwidth 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'performance_metrics_by_appliance' 
  AND datacenter = '$datacenter' 
  AND appliance_id = '$appliance' 
  AND $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, avg_read_latency, avg_write_latency, avg_latency, 
  avg_read_iops, avg_write_iops, avg_total_iops, 
  avg_read_bandwidth, avg_write_bandwidth, avg_total_bandwidth 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'performance_metrics_by_node' 
  AND datacenter = '$datacenter' 
  AND node_id = '$node' 
  AND $__timeFilter(time) 
ORDER BY time

SELECT datacenter, name, "sizeAllocated", "sizeTotal" 
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (datacenter, name) 
        datacenter, 
        name, 
        "sizeAllocated", 
        "sizeTotal",
        time
    FROM unity_metrics 
    WHERE datacenter LIKE '$datacenter' 
      AND $__timeFilter(time) 
      AND resource_type = 'lun' 
    ORDER BY datacenter, name, time DESC
) latest_metrics
ORDER BY "sizeAllocated" DESC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cluster_id) as clusters 
FROM powerstore_performance 
WHERE entity = 'space_metrics_by_cluster' AND $__timeFilter(time)
